name: Death from Below / Death from Below 2

values.meaning: health threshold below which enemy champions are executed
physical damage to enemies hit who are not executed
values.binNote: The wiki's non-execute damage (125-275, +0.4 bonus AD, +0.75 per lethality) is exactly half of PykeR#RDamage (250-550, +0.8 bonus AD, +1.5 per lethality), matching PykeR.ReducedDamage=0.5 applied to RDamage. No calculation row states the halved numbers directly; they are derived as RDamage * ReducedDamage, confirmed by the tooltip-only row PykeR#ReducedDamageFinal.

values.meaning: duration of the free recast window after a champion is killed inside the X
values.quote: can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost

mechanics.claim: Death from Below applies raw damage (ignoring resistances) to executed targets and area damage (mitigated by resistances) to targets above the threshold.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|raw damage}} to executed targets and {{tip|area damage}} to targets above the threshold.

mechanics.claim: Death from Below cannot execute clones; they always take the 50% physical damage instead.
mechanics.quote: ''Death from Below'' cannot execute {{tip|clone|clones}}. They are always dealt 50% {{as|physical damage}}.

mechanics.claim: If Death from Below hits an enemy champion, or a champion is killed inside the X, Pyke blinks to the center of the X.
mechanics.quote: '''Pyke''' will {{tip|blink}} to the center of the ''X''

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, not after the effect resolves.
Death from Below cannot be interrupted, and Pyke will still strike/blink even if displaced during the cast time (unless suppressed).
mechanics.quote: ''Death from Below'' cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}; '''Pyke''' will always appear at the target location if enemy champions are caught inside the ''X'' even if he is moved

mechanics.claim: Spell shields do not prevent Pyke from blinking to the location.
